facts.raw_span: A 78-year-old woman
history of two prior catheter ablations for persistent atrial fibrillation
presented with palpitations
atrial cycle length of 280 ms
positive P waves in leads II, III, aVF, and V₁
counterclockwise propagation around the mitral annulus and left atrial appendage
interrupted by a low-voltage scar at the prior mitral isthmus line
postpacing intervals within 20 ms of the tachycardia cycle length at the inferior and lateral mitral annulus and at the left atrial appendage–left pulmonary vein ridge
postpacing interval more than 20 ms longer than the cycle length when pacing adjacent to the mitral isthmus scar
activation within the vein of Marshall that matched the tachycardia cycle length
an epicardial pathway bypassing the scar
a 2F octapolar catheter was advanced into the vein of Marshall
